intro: I’m Joel Saludares, a systems developer with experience in building business applications, automating processes, and working with data to support operational teams.
My background includes HR, payroll, lending, inventory, reporting, Excel/VBA automation, UAT, implementation support, and database-driven application development.
I care about practical solutions: clear workflows, reliable data, maintainable systems, and tools that help people do their work with less friction.

howIThink.quote: Technology becomes useful when it makes the real work easier to understand, control, and improve.
howIThink.description: My approach starts with the operation, not the technology. The system should support the workflow instead of forcing people to work around it.
